run_FF_analysis: run the FF_analysis module to generate force field error plots and MAE statistics for CO2 and H2O
create_get_data: create a function that reads a JSON file of DFT and force field data and splits it by molecule type
build_binned_average: build a function that computes the average prediction error within user-defined energy bins
test_phys_err: test the physisorption error calculation by computing MAE for DFT values between 0 and -0.5 eV
review_get_Fig4a: review the histogram plotting function that visualizes raw error distributions for CO2 and H2O
